name: Dürbheim (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Dürbheim (a red stag on white).
history: Municipal flag of Dürbheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Dürbheim arms — red stag on white
